report.explanation: The only evidence is a short memory-retention series for service order: retained bytes rise 10->40 then fall to 5, with releases occurring and GC cycle 1 completing (BEFORE/AFTER). Direction is FLAT_OR_MIXED with no sustained increase, and retained bytes stay well under the 100-byte limit. A short increase alone cannot establish a leak, so no bounded root-cause candidate is supported; hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Sustained memory-retention increase across a longer window for service order (current samples are flat/mixed, delta -5 bytes)
Evidence of retained bytes approaching or exceeding retention_limit_bytes (peak 40 of 100)
Independent evidence of a leak or unbounded growth beyond the single trace sample set
